title: Recipient discovery
current: A direct item address resolves to its live claim holder. Before a holder exists, mail queues for an in-flight steering launch and is delivered to that launch’s bound session after it claims the item. Without either, sending refuses zero_recipients and names any launch found. Queued mail never follows a replacement worker. Message previews and sends refuse --project combined with --item, --epic-task, --process or --session; drop --project because the item ref names its project. Bulk messages default to present sessions with working or between_turns tool activity, including parked holders; heartbeat freshness never admits silent or gone sessions. Explicit liveness filters keep their legacy meaning. Bulk messages omit the sender; an explicit session or held-item address still delivers to it. Shared manual-wake resolution is unchanged. This behavior has source tests; deployed proof is pending.
